stock.scope: authorized synthetic lab view, not whole-community census
stock.stock_scope: CURRENT visibility and availability; not historical stock reconstruction
stock.deduplication: Canonical object IDs only; physical duplicates and ownership unverified
stock.confirmed_available: UNKNOWN: self declarations are not verification
stock.completeness: PARTIAL; missing values are not zero
stock.unit: BTC accounting only; no backing or transfer

valuation_example.rounding: ROUND_HALF_EVEN; total to 8 BTC decimal places

tables.name: challenges
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE challenges(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, actor TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
          target TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, expires INTEGER NOT NULL,
          receipt TEXT)

tables.name: denials
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE denials(target TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

tables.name: events
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, target TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL,
          body TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(target,version))

tables.name: goods
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE goods(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
          version INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL,
          created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

tables.name: metadata
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE metadata(version TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

tables.name: principals
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE principals(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

tables.name: valuations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE valuations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, target TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES goods(id), quantity TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL)

durable_registry: NOT IMPLEMENTED; in-memory lab only; restore rejected
independent_source_verification: NOT EXECUTED; pinned synthetic fixtures only
